shared_environment_policy: Reuse exact captured shared environment/wheel metadata from executor export; no recursive live venv or wheel-cache copy. Shared captured metadata is a dated snapshot, not asserted unchanged live.
input_asset_policy: Original TASK assets/cache source-referenced, no raw encoding or retransmission of trusted objects.
failure_scope: Per-request source root/runtime/attempts evidence retained with source index; local executor failure/transfer originals retained at original request paths, not recopied into a full history packet.
scope_qualification: All registered existing source material disposed; external full environment excluded as requested. Not a whole-host or new scientific audit.
